results.snippet:
Courses will be mostly in English. The remaining few courses in French will be repeated in English in small groups. The DEODIS and VESONTIO research teams within the DISC Department at FEMTO-ST have research activities with international partners. Their research production is international as well.

### Advantages of the program

This Master program in Computer Science includes long research periods in the laboratory, which constitute an in-depth approach to scientific research. [...] DEODIS team: High-performance computing, distributed synchronization, distributed systems, and distributed artificial intelligence.
 VESONTIO team: Models and specifications, cyber-physical systems, critical systems, and advanced testing.

### Objectives

This track, taught in English, is primarily research-oriented and serves as a springboard for pursuing a PhD in Computer Science. This track also opens R&D opportunities in companies.

### International dimension [...] ### Who can apply?

This training program welcomes students in Computer Science who are curious and interested in research.

### Expectations of the training

Skills targeted:

 Analyze and model a complex system or a software,
 Develop a software system,
 Manage complex communicating computer systems
 Manage a group project and communicate on activities
 Identify and integrate a professional environment
